title: Order and Pascal depth of Pascal finite automorphisms of the plane
summary: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$. For a Pascal finite automorphism $F$ of the affine plane we show that its order is determined by its Pascal depth, $|F|=p^{\lceil\log_pτ_K(F)\rceil}$, and that, combined with Dolgachev's theorem on the plane Cremona group, this pins the order spectrum of Pascal finite plane automorphisms to $\{1,p,p^2\}$ and bounds the Pascal depth by $τ_K(F)\le p^2$. For the polynomial group $\text{GA}_2(K)$ we give a second, independent proof of the order-$p^2$ ceiling, a purely group-theoretic argument from the Jung--van der Kulk amalgam and Serre's tree…
